answer: A newcomer earns a seat by holding one water right at a named oasis: the holder draws one bucket with a copper dipper, and a wandering inspector checks the dipper's seal against the oasis register the same day. A tampered dipper, or one right claimed at two oases, voids the claim and burns a 500 POA bond. Each right costs $170 to register plus a $60 inspector fee, so 100 fakes need 100 rights, $23,000 in fees and 50,000 POA in bonds.
